headline: The most snow is likely on day 2: about 5 in at the mid-mountain gauge (range 2 to 7), from 0.35 in of water.

points.text: Wind aloft from the west-northwest at 39 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 26 F, base about 33 F. Snow quality: light (about 15 in of snow per inch of water). Ridge winds near 20 mph from the west will load east-facing slopes just below the ridges heavily. Moisture: 7 mm of water in the column, 73% humidity near ridge level.

Wind aloft from the northwest at 42 mph (northwest flow). Mid-mountain about 25 F, base about 33 F. Snow quality: average (about 13 in of snow per inch of water). Ridge winds near 21 mph from the west will load east-facing slopes just below the ridges heavily. Moisture: 4 mm of water in the column, 70% humidity near ridge level.
Wind aloft from the west at 36 mph (west flow). Mid-mountain about 22 F, base about 31 F.

resembles: Nothing on record is close. The nearest day is Dec 5, 2025, part of the Dec 5-8, 2025 storm (1.2 in of water over 4 days). That day brought about 8.1 in of snow at mid-mountain (0.55 in of water at the gauge).
